units.source_text: 不知不觉间下起了雷阵雨。

en.t: Before they knew it, a thunderstorm had begun.

units.source_text: 千重子不用说，恐怕就连在这个村子长大的苗子也没留意到就下起来了。

en.t: Needless to say, Chieko had not noticed; perhaps even Naeko, who had grown up in this village, had failed to realize that it had started raining.

units.source_text: 不是小雨，也不是毛毛雨。

en.t: It was not a light rain, nor was it a drizzle.
